newsitem.title: GERMANY: Berlin probing E.German sports officials on doping.
newsitem.headline: Berlin probing E.German sports officials on doping.

text.p: Leading members of the former East German sports establishment are under investigation for doping programmes which helped make their athletes the envy of the world, Berlin authorities confirmed on Sunday.

Berlin justice ministry spokesman Ruediger Reiff confirmed a report in the news magazine Der Spiegel that Rudi Hellmann, head of sport in the former communist East Germany and other senior officials were being investigated.
But Reiff denied that criminal proceedings had been initiated against East Germany's last leader, Egon Krenz.
The magazine said authorities were investigating around 50 former politicians, doctors and trainers and said charges would be made this summer with trials beginning in the autumn.
Der Spiegel, in a copy released ahead of publication on Monday, said East Germany pursued a systematic doping programme, particularly in swimming, athletics and weight lifting.
